note: Both sets share significant errors: misbinding the 3'-7" dimension to Grid 5 (it belongs to Grid 2/A4), misidentifying the 6" vertical dimension as width (it is height), misidentifying the 5'-0" offset as beam length, and inventing a 2" top edge distance for the E6 roof beam. However, Set B contains a specific hallucination claiming B1 (Floor Beam Near Grid 5) has 3" diameter openings, whereas the drawing shows B1 has rectangular openings (W10X15) and only C1/E6 (W8X13) have 3" circular openings. Set A avoids this error.
remarks: Both sets struggle with distinguishing beam length from offset dimensions and opening height from width. Set B's confusion of beam types (attributing C1/E6 circular openings to B1) is a notable fidelity failure.
